bio: Hi, I’m Kayla, also known as KK or Kay, and I’m the heart behind Okaystyledu. I’m incredibly passionate about what I do and deeply grateful for the opportunity and talent I’ve been blessed with. I truly love serving my clients and providing quality hair-care services that leave you feeling confident, beautiful, and cared for. When I’m not behind the chair, I enjoy reading, fashion, fitness, discovering new hobbies, and continuously perfecting my craft. I believe there’s always something new to learn, create, and improve. Thank you for trusting me with your crown. 🤍

services.name: Sew-Ins
services.description: Secure, beautiful sew-in installs tailored to your look.

policies: Please arrive with hair washed, blow-dried, and free of product unless your selected service includes a wash. Contact the CEO with any questions before your appointment.
Cash, Apple Pay, Cash App, Zelle, PayPal, and other accepted payment methods are available. No checks. Remaining balance must be paid in full before leaving.
Please reschedule if you are feeling unwell. Sanitation and hygiene protocols are followed, and additional safety procedures may apply when needed.
Deposits are final and non-refundable. Refunds are considered only for service errors or cancellations by the provider/CEO. Service concerns should be reported within 24 hours.
Please cancel at least 24 hours in advance. No-shows and same-day cancellations forfeit the deposit. Repeated no-shows may be blocked from booking.

Arrive at least 10 minutes early. A 10–15 minute grace period applies for late arrivals; after the grace period, the appointment may be cancelled or a late fee may apply. Exact address is provided after booking confirmation. Please respect home/personal space.
No extra guests unless approved. No children unless they are receiving a service.
Photos/videos of finished styles may be taken for business promotion. Client participation can be treated as optional.
